title: Urugomero rwasenyuye Ubwami
intro: Igihugu c’inzuzi zitemba, amatongo abiri y’ivyatsi bitotahaye, n’uguterimbere kutagira uko kungana — ariko abakibamwo barakura ntibitaho Uwabahezagiye. Igihe ivyibutsa vyaza bibahamagara ngo basubireyo, barahindukira. Ivyakurikiyeho ni igihano kiguma kivuga nk’imburi. None uwo muryango wa kera wari nde?
clues: Twabaye mu gihugu cahezagiwe cane ku buryo inzu yacu yari hagati y’amatongo abiri y’ivyatsi bitotahaye.
Twararyoherwa n’inzuzi zica mu bihugu vyacu be n’umwimbu mwinshi wuzuye mu mihana yacu.
Yamara rero igihe twahamagarirwa gukenguruka no kwumvira Umukama wacu, twahindukiye mu bwibone.
Ubutunzi bwacu n’ukworoha kwacu vyatumye twibagirwa Uwabiduhaye vyose.
Hanyuma haza umugezi w’amazi utunguranye, uca mu nzitizi nini twari twizigiye.
Turi abantu b’i Saba’, igihugu cabo cari kizwi kubera urugomero runini rwa Ma’rib.

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
